issue.description: Build a reusable static PGN analysis app with local Stockfish evaluation, replay, move quality labels, and browser verification. Publish it to chess.jedarden.com through Forgejo, Argo/Cloudflare Pages, and required DNS/custom-domain setup. Keep site copy independent of other chess services. Record verification and deployment references.
issue.notes: Implemented browser chess analysis at chess.jedarden.com: PGN input/upload, local Stockfish 19 small network, animated board replay, running White-perspective score graph, move quality labels, summary, and Agentation. Paths: index.html, src/, public/, scripts/, tests/, README.md. Decisions: labels are transparent WDL/centipawn heuristics; no calibrated Elo from one game. Verification: npm test (5 pass); npm run build (pass); Chromium local and live sample game 68/68 positions, final +M1, crossOriginIsolated true, Agentation mounted, no browser errors or mobile overflow. Initial app commit ca1063ea; Forgejo public and GitHub mirror synced. Cloudflare Pages project chess-jedarden-com, custom domain active, DNS CNAME proxied, direct initial deployment a6bbe2b8. GitOps deployment in declarative-config commit 0456ea2f, paths k8s/iad-ci/argo-events/{github-eventsource,website-build-sensor}.yml, target iad-ci argo-events-ns-iad-ci Synced/Healthy. Automated workflow push verification pending.
